layers.message: Add percentage coupons to order totals

graderOnly: The unstaged change to src/totals.js replaces Math.floor with Math.round in discountCents. This restores the nearest-cent rounding the request requires: the review reproducer, one BAG-02 at 1995 cents with SAVE10, now totals 1795. The approved plan intent is unchanged.
The existing test command node --test test/totals.test.js passes on the working tree. Those tests do not cover coupons.
No downstream rerun is needed before implementation review.
EXPEDITED cycles have no Tester phase, so no verification record should exist. F-001 in the implementation review stays OPEN for the Reviewer to reassess.

the unstaged correction rounds the half-cent discount to the nearest cent, so the self-checks pass
the committed code the review assessed truncates the discount (the F-001 reproducer)

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture: a plain-JS order totals module. 00-project (pre-install) adds subtotal code and node:test tests. 50-coupons starts the first cycle as EXPEDITED. It adds src/coupons.js and a discountCents built on Math.floor, a COMPLETE development plan (DEV-001, DEV-002, Acceptance EXPEDITED_REQUEST, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE), and STATE at REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION after a FORWARD. 51-review adds the implementation review: BLOCKED, F-001 OPEN with Owner Developer, citing the assessed commit through COMMIT substitution. It also sets STATE to DEVELOPING with a FAILURE from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION and one frame: Owner DEVELOPING, ResumeAt REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, RerunThrough NONE. 52-correction (unstaged) is the earlier Developer session's correction. It switches src/totals.js to Math.round and reopens DEV-002 to IN_PROGRESS (plan IN_PROGRESS), with an implementation note that the fix is in the working tree but its self-check evidence is not yet recorded. The expected run records the self-check, marks DEV-002 DONE and the plan COMPLETE, pops the frame, RESUMEs to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, and gives a fresh-chat Reviewer invocation for IMPLEMENTATION with advisory model guidance. No records use AC identifiers, because the cycle is EXPEDITED. No CONTEXT.md exists, because the first cycle was expedited and no audit ran.
